statusLine.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".workspace.current_dir"); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".model.display_name"); transcript=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".transcript_path"); cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null; branch=$(git -c core.commitGraph=false -c gc.auto=0 branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "no-git"); if [ -f "$transcript" ]; then size=$(wc -c < "$transcript" 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); tokens=$((size / 4)); pct=$((tokens * 100 / 200000)); [ $pct -gt 100 ] && pct=100; ctx="${pct}%"; else ctx="N/A"; fi; printf "\033[36m🤖 %s\033[0m │ \033[33m📁 %-30s\033[0m │ \033[32m🌿 %s\033[0m │ \033[35m📊 %s\033[0m" "$model" "${cwd/#$HOME/~}" "$branch" "$ctx"'
